description_en: Queries the list of voice call tasks
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs query-ai-call-task-page --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --status INIT --task-name '测试任务' --agent-name '测试智能体' --task-id 118700000000000000 --application-code 0250000C98 --source 0 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryAiCallTaskPage

parameters.help_en: The current page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页。取值大于0，默认值：1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in paging. Settings for the number of rows per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:
INIT: init (not started).
FAILED: startup failed.
RUNNING: running.
STOPPED: stopped
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：
INIT：初始化（未启动）。
FAILED：启动失败。
RUNNING：运行中。
STOPPED：已停止
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The task name. The system performs a fuzzy match based on the task name
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，系统根据任务名称模糊检索
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The agent name. The system performs a fuzzy match based on the agent name
parameters.help_zh: 智能体名称，系统根据智能体名称模糊检索
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.help_en:
The creation source. Valid values:

0: created by agent.

1: created by engine
parameters.help_zh:
创建来源：取值

0：智能体创建

1：引擎创建
parameters.name: source
